name: HoneyBook
description:
If you run your business on HoneyBook, this connector lets you do a lot of it right from Claude, just by asking.

Want to know where things stand? Ask for a rundown of your active projects, look up a client before a call, pull up an invoice or contract, skim a message thread, or see how revenue and leads are tracking this month.

Need to actually get something done? Claude can create and update projects, jot down a note after a meeting, set dates, and add or edit client contacts. It only does this when you say so. Anything that changes your data is off by default, and you decide what to turn on.

We kept the permissions honest and easy to read. Viewing your data and changing it are two separate switches, so an app can look without touching. The bigger stuff, like company settings or letting a pro or bookkeeper in, is always asked for on its own and never slipped in with everything else. And Claude only ever works on the account you connect.

It's built for the way independent businesses actually work: photographers, planners, consultants, and everyone juggling clients, projects, and getting paid. Think of it as a faster way to stay on top of your book of business, whether that's a quick morning catch-up, prepping for the next client, or capturing what just happened on a call.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HoneyBook to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HoneyBook to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.api.honeybook.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HoneyBook MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HoneyBook provides these MCP tools: find_action, get_guidance, take_action, and take_action_read_only.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HoneyBook?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HoneyBook in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
HoneyBook requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HoneyBook is developed by Honeybook. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
